name: hpm-mfgtool-helper
description: Discover HPM devices and perform manufacturing ROM operations through the installed Manufacturing CMD.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, program, and inspect HPM ROM targets.
interface.longDescription: Configure Manufacturing CMD, discover serial and HID devices, and query, read, program, erase, load, or reset HPM ROM targets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my manufacturing setup and discover connected HPM devices.
